title: Straighter reeds: the switch you turned down was judged on trees
question: Should the reed stand dead straight like B, or does A's wander look more alive? B needs a world-wide switch, so this is your call rather than mine.
context_md:
**Your three asks from the last card, and where each one got to.**

*Fewer seeds* -- done, and it was the big one. Measured on the same bed at 20,000 frames: seeds **550 -> 27**, and the pile on the sediment **367 -> 7**. Seeds were **49% of everything in that pond** and are now **7%**. Both arms below already have this.

*Less crowding* -- followed from the seed cut, as you predicted. Standing plants 594 -> 44: fewer, bigger plants instead of a mat.

*Seeds caught in the reeds* -- you were literally right, and there is a reason. **121 of the 550 were resting on reed tissue.** A seed falls through a plant by scanning down for **air**, and stops at the first cell that is neither air nor plant. Under a reed in a pond there is no air, there is water -- so the rule, written for litter dropping through a tree crown, cannot see a landing. The seed cut takes it to 13, which is why I have not touched the rule; say the word if you want it fixed properly.

**Which leaves straightness, and it is not a tuning question.**

I raised the reed's own stiffness and it did nothing, because `stem_stiffness` is **switched off world-wide by default** -- the selector forces 0.0 and never reads what a species authored. B is that switch turned on. Nothing else differs between these two.

**The one verdict on this mechanism is yours and it was "looks identical" -- on trees.** A tree's wobble sits under thickening and a canopy. A reed is one cell wide, standing alone in open water, with nothing to hide it. That is why I am asking again rather than treating it as already answered.

**What turning it on would cost:** it is a global selector, so every plant in the world gets it, not just the reed.

items.label: A -- as it stands now (switch off, the shipped default)
items.caption: The seed cut only. Stems wander as they climb.

items.label: B -- same bed, stem stiffness switched on
items.caption: Identical in every other respect. Stems hold the line they are spelling.
